What's in your audit

  • Where you rank on Google today for the searches that matter to your business
  • Technical issues slowing your site down or keeping pages out of search
  • On-page fixes for titles, descriptions, headings and content
  • How you stack up against the competitors outranking you
  • Your top 3 priorities, in the order that will move rankings fastest

Why Better Bridge

Better Bridge is a nonprofit offering free personal finance and small business education, a free budgeting app, and free Playbook textbooks for community programs.

Better Bridge pledges that 100% of donations go to building its free app, printing free textbooks, and outreach.
